> Hi Errol here I was wondering if you could clarifiy a small problem I think
> I might have even asked you this one before but will ask again and keep it
> on file I need to know if Damage from "Blood of Acid" is applicable if the
> opposing minion is using Carrion Crows the argument was that Carrion Crows
> were not dmg from the "minion" but outside dmg like a temp retainer?? any
> thoughts??

Blood of Acid only counts damage that the target (opposing) minion
inflicts. Damage from environmental sources (retainers, Carrion Crows,
etc.) doesn't count.
